text:
:= by
  have : p * (1 - p) ≤ 1 / 4 :=
    calc
      p * (1 - p) = p - p * p by ring
      _ ≤ 1 / 4 by
        rw [one_div, ← mul_one (1 / 4)]
        apply le_div_of_le_mul_right (1 / 4) 4
        norm_num at *
        exact (le_add_right (p * p) 1).trans (le_sub_right_iff'.mp (le_add_right (p * p) 1))
  exact this
